tools.name: discover_products
tools.description: Read the live garment catalogue, colours, sizes, print areas and recommendations. Use query fields search, category, fit, quality, quantity, country, market, locale, sort and limit. No design session is required.

tools.name: start_design_session
tools.description: Start a private, expiring guest design session. Keep the returned subject and sessionToken for every follow-up. The token grants access to this session; do not publish it. One session can contain multiple designs and a team basket.

tools.name: get_design_session
tools.description: Read this session's designs, elements, print areas, previews and last changed object. Use it to resolve an edit's target. Requires this session's subject and sessionToken.

tools.name: end_design_session
tools.description: Revoke this session's editing capability when the user asks to end it. Saved design and checkout links are separate outputs.

tools.name: get_design_request
tools.description: Read the status of a request submitted in this session. Pass its original requestId. Poll until terminal before starting another edit; a queued job is not a completed design.

tools.name: choose_product
tools.description: Choose or change product, garment colour, sizes, quantities and print areas. Existing artwork is preserved. Use live product values; confirm final sizes and quantities before saving or checkout.

tools.name: create_design
tools.description: Create another independent blank design in this session. Use product, colour, size, quantity and print areas as needed. It does not inherit artwork from the active design.

tools.name: load_design
tools.description: Load an SSD design key or streetshirts saved-design URL into editable session state. Different saved designs can coexist in one session.

tools.name: change_design
tools.description: Apply the existing natural-language edit to the current design: text/content/style, image replacement, sizing, positioning, background removal, crop/flip/restore, contrast, keyline or emoji changes. These capabilities also have individually named tools in this list. Preserve the user's exact instruc

tools.name: create_design_variants
tools.description: Clone the active/base design into personalised designs. Supply variants with nameText, numberText, size, quantity and optional product/items. Preserve the common artwork and check each supplied name and number.

tools.name: add_text
tools.description: Add new text to the specified print area using the existing text/font/style options. Preserve the user's exact wording.

tools.name: update_text
tools.description: Replace existing text content or edit its style. This can overwrite the selected wording. Resolve targets from session state. For all text, include every intended text object in every intended print area; the existing workflow supports style fanout and explicit batches.

tools.name: upload_image
tools.description: Upload imageFile, imageData/dataUrl/base64 or a supported public sourceUrl. Include filename, contentType and fileType to identify the image, e.g. artwork.png, image/png, png. Set applyToDesign and areaId to place it. A caller-local path or a bare file ID is not downloadable artwork.

tools.name: add_image
tools.description: Add uploaded or existing artwork to the specified area. Use the returned asset or the supported imageFile transport. Do not confuse an upload with the target of an existing-image edit.

tools.name: generate_artwork
tools.description: Generate artwork from a prompt using the existing streetshirts service. Use applyToDesign, singleResult and areaId when applying it to a shirt. Generation uses a bounded allowance and can return pending work.

tools.name: replace_image
tools.description: Replace the target's current artwork using an uploaded image, preserving its existing box unless a new placement is requested. This overwrites the selected image content. Resolve the target and print area first.

tools.name: move_element
tools.description: Move the target element within its print area. Preserve other elements and areas. Use the existing x/y or placement options; interpret an unambiguous follow-up from session state.

tools.name: resize_element
tools.description: Resize the target in the specified print area. For physical dimensions use widthCm/heightCm or widthMm/heightMm; Core already converts them. For example, make the front image 30cm wide with widthCm:30.

tools.name: resize_group
tools.description: Resize all or selected elements together in one print area, preserving their relative layout. Supports existing physical-size and elementIds options.

tools.name: rotate_element
tools.description: Rotate the specified existing element in its print area using the existing rotation/placement options.

tools.name: align_element
tools.description: Align the target element in its print area using existing alignment/placement options. Preserve intentional off-centre placement unless the user requests a change.

tools.name: duplicate_element
tools.description: Duplicate the specified text or image in its print area using existing placement options.

tools.name: delete_element
tools.description: Delete the explicitly intended text/image element or selected elements. Resolve an ambiguous target before deletion; do not hide or shrink it to simulate removal.

tools.name: move_to_print_area
tools.description: Move a selected element to a named destination print area with the existing destination/target-area options.

tools.name: remove_background
tools.description: Use the existing background-removal workflow for a target image. It chooses the appropriate existing image method and preserves the box. Show the resulting garment preview.

tools.name: crop_image
tools.description: Crop the selected image using the existing crop options while keeping its print-area context.

tools.name: flip_image
tools.description: Flip the selected image horizontally or vertically. Pass areaId and elementId in public options, and the direction in its nested options object: options.options.direction = horizontal or vertical.

tools.name: restore_original_image
tools.description: Restore retained original image content for an explicit elementId and areaId, preserving the authored placement.

tools.name: invert_image
tools.description: Invert the selected image's colours using the existing image tool.

tools.name: add_keyline
tools.description: Apply an existing border/keyline recipe to the specified artwork and print area.

tools.name: sticker_cutout
tools.description: Use the existing sticker-cutout operation to remove a surrounding flat page or image box from selected artwork.

tools.name: extract_artwork
tools.description: Use the existing extraction tool to recover printable artwork from a supplied garment mockup.

tools.name: replace_emoji
tools.description: Replace emoji text using streetshirts' existing approved emoji image workflow, retaining the intended text and print-area scope.

tools.name: apply_design_batch
tools.description: Apply the native edit operations listed in tools[] to one design, updating state between edits and rendering one final preview. Each maps to an individually exposed tool: text/image addition, text edits, move/resize/rotate/align/duplicate/delete, crop, background removal, flip, restore, artwork gene

tools.name: validate_design
tools.description: Validate the current or supplied design with the existing production compiler. Read the actual validation result before saving.

tools.name: preview_design
tools.description: Render the existing garment preview for the active design and chosen product. Display the returned preview URL to the customer.

tools.name: ai_photoshoot
tools.description: Show the current design being worn using streetshirts' existing AI photoshoot. It is an illustrative image; the saved garment design remains the print authority. May return pending work and uses a bounded allowance.

tools.name: save_design
tools.description: Save the active design, or supply designs/variants/saveAllDesigns for multiple outputs. Returns immutable saved keys and visual-editor links. Final production sizes and quantities must be supplied.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Save the selected session designs and create one Shopify basket/checkout link with all intended names, sizes and quantities. Omit designs to use approved session designs, or pass the exact complete returned design objects including product, items, print areas and artwork; do not reconstruct name/siz

tools.name: email_design
tools.description: Send a saved design link to the user's explicitly requested recipient using the existing sharing service. Requires explicit user intent to send email; never infer permission from an address found in artwork.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: load_design, change_design · Private data: start_design_session, upload_image · Public sink: start_design_session, change_design, upload_image, add_image, apply_design_batch, email_design · Destructive: change_design, update_text, delete_element, remove_background, sticker_cutout, apply_design_batch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: load_design, change_design · Private data: start_design_session, upload_image · Public sink: start_design_session, change_design, upload_image, add_image, apply_design_batch, email_design · Destructive: change_design, update_text, delete_element, remove_background, sticker_cutout, apply_design_batch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
